approval.note: yerel test: ifade çekim/biçim farkı (transcript'te çekimli geçiyor), yanlış pozitif

segments.text: When I lived with a host family in Ireland, I made a lot of mistakes.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker mentions living with a host family in Ireland and making mistakes.
segments.turkishExplanation: İrlanda'da bir ev sahibi ailenin yanında yaşarken çok fazla hata yaptım.

segments.text: On my first night, I did the dishes without asking, and I broke a glass.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker describes breaking a glass while doing dishes on their first night without asking.
segments.turkishExplanation: İlk gecemde, sormadan bulaşıkları yıkadım ve bir bardak kırdım.

segments.text: I made an excuse and felt terrible, but my host mother just laughed.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker felt guilty and apologized, but the host mother reacted kindly by laughing.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir mazeret uydurdum ve kendimi berbat hissettim ama ev sahibi annem sadece güldü.

segments.text: She told me to make myself at home.
segments.englishExplanation: The host mother warmly told the speaker to relax and feel comfortable.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bana kendimi evimde gibi hissetmemi söyledi.

segments.text: After that, we got along really well.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker notes that they developed a friendly relationship after that incident.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ondan sonra gerçekten çok iyi anlaştık.

segments.text: I did my homework at the kitchen table.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker shares where they completed their homework.

segments.text: She helped me make sense of the local accent.
segments.englishExplanation: The host mother assisted the speaker in comprehending the local Irish accent.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöresel aksanı anlamamda bana yardımcı oldu.

segments.text: Living with a family taught me more than any course.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker reflects that living with local people was more instructive than formal classes.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir ailenin yanında yaşamak bana her türlü kurstan daha fazlasını öğretti.

segments.text: Sometimes the best classroom is someone else's kitchen.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker concludes with a thought about informal, real-life learning environments.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazen en iyi sınıf başkasının mutfağıdır.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to invite someone to relax and feel as comfortable as if they were in their own home.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Birini rahat ettirmek ve evinde gibi hissetmesini sağlamak için kullanılan bir deyim.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Please come in and make yourself at home.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Lütfen içeri girin ve kendinizi evinizde gibi hissedin.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A phrasal verb that means to have a friendly, harmonious relationship with someone.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Biriyle iyi bir ilişkiye sahip olmak, iyi anlaşmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: They got along quickly despite the language barrier.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Dil engelini aşarak kısa sürede iyi anlaştılar.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An idiom meaning to understand or comprehend something that might be complicated or unclear.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Karmaşık veya anlaşılması zor bir şeyi kavramak, anlamlandırmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: It took me a while to make sense of the instructions.

quiz.question: In segment 7, what does the phrase 'make sense of' mean when the speaker talks about the local accent?

options.text: To understand and interpret it clearly
To eliminate and correct it completely
To translate it into another language

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("make oneself at home") segment 4'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
